summary: Iteration 4 (Gemini AI features via emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (~19s) covering POST /api/ai/confession (hi + en, empty->400), /api/ai/reflection (hi, empty->400) and /api/ai/chat (single-turn, multi-turn history, empty->400). All success responses returned valid JSON with the correct keys, non-empty strings, and Hindi (devanagari) content when lang='hi'. Frontend (390x844, default Hindi): Today shows both ai-generate-card and ai-assistant-card under the AI section. /generate: generate-input + generate-button work; empty submit surfaces the 'कृपया अपनी स्थिति लिखें' error toast; a real prompt returns a first-person Hindi confession card (starting 'मैं...') and a prayer card inside generate-result within ~15s; generate-back-button returns to Today. /assistant: initial Hindi greeting bubble at chat-msg-0, sending a message appends chat-msg-1 (user) + chat-msg-2 (assistant reply, 634-char Hindi response) — assistant-back-button returns. Reader: reader-reflect-button is correctly HIDDEN on confession/prayer steps and VISIBLE only on verse steps; tapping it opens the bottom modal titled 'आज का मनन' (reflect_title) with a loading spinner then AI reflection text in Hindi within ~45s. Deprecated warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) unchanged from iteration 3, non-blocking. No red-screen errors, no failed API calls.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use style.boxShadow. Non-blocking (carried over from iteration 3).
props.pointerEvents is deprecated — move to style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking (carried over).
useNativeDriver warning on web preview only; fine on native. Non-blocking (carried over).

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Address the three carried-over RN-web deprecation warnings when convenient.

server.py: `logger` is still defined AFTER it is used inside create_tts/ai_* endpoints (logging.basicConfig at bottom of file). If any exception path hits before module fully evaluated it could NameError; safe to move logger init to top.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L74/L150 etc.: `logger` referenced before its definition at L342. Move logging setup above route handlers. Currently works only because handlers execute after module import completes.
server.py grew to 347 lines mixing TTS + Gemini AI — still under 700-line threshold but consider extracting /api/ai/* into a separate module for clarity.
ai.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct). No hardcoded URLs, no swallow of network errors beyond toast — good.
seed_data_creation: None. AI endpoints are stateless; no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gemini via emergentintegrations model 'gemini-3-flash-preview' returns Hindi JSON reliably in ~2-6s per call; allow up to 45s in UI tests. testIDs used: ai-generate-card, ai-assistant-card, generate-input/button/back-button, generate-result, assistant-input/send-button/back-button, chat-msg-{i}, reader-reflect-button (verse steps only), reflect modal title uses key 'reflect_title' which renders as 'आज का मनन' in Hindi. Reader step order: confession (idx 0) -> 7 verses -> prayer.
